scope: Corollary 10.10 (No-growth and rank on the entire tail) of the manuscript “Eventual categoricity for abstract elementary classes” (preprints/Eventual-Categoricity-for-Abstract-Elementary-Classes-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 240 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dcb7401285f5ac78), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 85. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Increase the threshold λ if necessary to include the bounds for the fixed point diagram. In arbitrary cardinalities, if A ≤K B are pointed models with ∥A∥ ≥ λ and P(A) = P(B), then A = B. Moreover, for every pointed model M with ∥M∥ > λ, |P(M)| = rk(P(M)) = ∥M∥. The point sets of strong submodels are relatively closed, and relative bases and finite basis supports are available as in Theorem 10.5; no eligibility condition is imposed on these arbitrary cardinalities.
